title: SAP MM/WM Senior Consultant
description:
SAP MM/WM Senior Consultant (12 month Project)

Functional expert in materials management and warehouse optimization.

Experience: 5 to 10+ years in SAP with a focus on complete implementations and ECC migrations.

Technical focus: Design and configuration of MM (Procure-to-Pay, Inventory) and WM (Warehouse Layout, Movements, and Strategies).

Integrations: Management of EDI/IDOC interfaces, radio frequency (RF) systems, and RICEF objects.

Plus: Experience in EWM and official certifications are valued.

Language: Fluent English (required).

Education: University degree in Accounting, Finance, Engineering, or Information Systems.

Added Value: Experience in large-scale projects, mergers, or acquisitions

Modality: Remote: although staff may work remotely, we expect them to travel to the US or Canada during the project implementation.

Expected duration of the assignment: 12 months

title: Cientista de dados - IA Generativa
description:
Buscamos Cientistas de Dados com foco e atuação em Inteligência Artificial, com experiência ou forte interesse em Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs).

A posição envolve atuar desde a compreensão do problema de negócio até a construção, experimentação e evolução de soluções baseadas em dados e IA, em colaboração próxima com times técnicos, de produto e áreas de negócio.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de IA Generativa, utilizando LLMs e abordagens baseadas em RAG.
  • Desenvolver, testar e evoluir pipelines de dados e modelos para casos de uso com IA Generativa.
  • Conduzir experimentações e validações contínuas, avaliando qualidade, relevância e confiabilidade das soluções.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de tecnologia, produto e negócio ao longo de todo o ciclo da solução.
  • Apoiar a integração de modelos em ambientes produtivos, considerando escalabilidade, monitoramento e manutenção.
  • Documentar soluções, decisões técnicas e aprendizados do projeto.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência como Cientista de Dados, atuando em projetos de machine learning e/ou inteligência artificial.
  • Vivência com IA Generativa (GenAI), incluindo LLMs e arquiteturas RAG.
  • Forte capacidade analítica para exploração, preparação e interpretação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em programação aplicada à análise de dados e modelagem.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com dados em ambientes produtivos e em times multidisciplinares.
  • Boa comunicação para explicar conceitos técnicos a públicos não técnicos.

A posição envolve atuar desde a compreensão do problema de negócio até a construção, experimentação e evolução de soluções baseadas em dados e IA, em colaboração próxima com times técnicos, de produto e áreas de negócio.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de IA Generativa, utilizando LLMs e abordagens baseadas em RAG.
  • Desenvolver, testar e evoluir pipelines de dados e modelos para casos de uso com IA Generativa.
  • Conduzir experimentações e validações contínuas, avaliando qualidade, relevância e confiabilidade das soluções.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de tecnologia, produto e negócio ao longo de todo o ciclo da solução.
  • Apoiar a integração de modelos em ambientes produtivos, considerando escalabilidade, monitoramento e manutenção.
  • Documentar soluções, decisões técnicas e aprendizados do projeto.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência como Cientista de Dados, atuando em projetos de machine learning e/ou inteligência artificial.
  • Vivência com IA Generativa (GenAI), incluindo LLMs e arquiteturas RAG.
  • Forte capacidade analítica para exploração, preparação e interpretação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em programação aplicada à análise de dados e modelagem.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com dados em ambientes produtivos e em times multidisciplinares.
  • Boa comunicação para explicar conceitos técnicos a públicos não técnicos.

title: Business Development Representative Mid
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We're privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word 'partner' over 'vendor', and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

About the Opportunity:

Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR. This person will be responsible for generating qualified leads and supporting the sales team with prospecting across different business lines, including AI, cloud, staffing, and internal products.

You'll work with modern tools and automations, including AI-powered content creation to assist in outreach. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow and have a direct impact on pipeline development.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead prospecting in the US market focused on setting qualified meetings.
  • Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.
  • Make cold calls when necessary.
  • Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.
  • Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).
  • Partner closely with Account Executives.

Requirements

  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.
  • Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.
  • Comfortable using prospecting and automation tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, results-driven, and motivated by performance.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling technology solutions (e.g., Google Cloud, AI, Salesforce).
  • Background in consulting or IT services companies.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce as a CRM.

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code's consultants are allocated to perform its services.

A atuação é voltada a projetos de desenvolvimento (novos produtos, novas funcionalidades e melhorias estruturadas), com foco em qualidade de código, performance e boa experiência do usuário.

  • Projetar e desenvolver novas aplicações SAP Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP, incluindo definição e implementação de serviços OData e CDS Views.

  • Ensino superior completo em área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou correlatas).

  • Experiência prática com SAP Fiori/UI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, SAPUI5) e consumo/criação de serviços OData.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações Webdynpro ABAP (criação e evolução de componentes, views e controllers).

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) DevOps Engineer para fazer parte do nosso movimento, com forte atuação em ambientes cloud e ecossistemas containerizados. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência, confiabilidade e escalabilidade das aplicações ao longo de todo o seu ciclo de vida — da estruturação da infraestrutura à operação em produção.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e evoluir ambientes em cloud, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e alta disponibilidade
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código, promovendo padronização e governança dos ambientes
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, assegurando entregas automatizadas e confiáveis
  • Apoiar a estruturação e melhoria de ambientes Kubernetes
  • Monitorar aplicações e infraestrutura, atuando de forma preventiva e corretiva quando necessário
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes e/ou na implementação de melhorias estruturais
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, apoiando decisões técnicas e evoluções arquiteturais.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência sólida com Kubernetes, atuando em ambientes produtivos
  • Vivência prática com Cloud (AWS, GCP ou OCI)
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código, especialmente Terraform
  • Experiência com práticas de GitOps, utilizando Argo CD
  • Experiência com CI/CD, principalmente utilizando GitLab CI, incluindo: criação e manutenção de pipelines, estratégias de deploy automatizado, integração com ambientes Kubernetes e versionamento e controle de releases
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade, como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace
  • Experiência com containers (Docker)
  • Vivência com troubleshooting e sustentação de ambientes críticos.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) DevOps Engineer para fazer parte do nosso movimento, com forte atuação em ambientes cloud e ecossistemas containerizados. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência, confiabilidade e escalabilidade das aplicações ao longo de todo o seu ciclo de vida — da estruturação da infraestrutura à operação em produção.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e evoluir ambientes em cloud, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e alta disponibilidade
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código, promovendo padronização e governança dos ambientes
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, assegurando entregas automatizadas e confiáveis
  • Apoiar a estruturação e melhoria de ambientes Kubernetes
  • Monitorar aplicações e infraestrutura, atuando de forma preventiva e corretiva quando necessário
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes e/ou na implementação de melhorias estruturais
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, apoiando decisões técnicas e evoluções arquiteturais.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência sólida com Kubernetes, atuando em ambientes produtivos
  • Vivência prática com Cloud (AWS, GCP ou OCI)
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código, especialmente Terraform
  • Experiência com práticas de GitOps, utilizando Argo CD
  • Experiência com CI/CD, principalmente utilizando GitLab CI, incluindo: criação e manutenção de pipelines, estratégias de deploy automatizado, integração com ambientes Kubernetes e versionamento e controle de releases
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade, como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace
  • Experiência com containers (Docker)
  • Vivência com troubleshooting e sustentação de ambientes críticos.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) DevOps Engineer para fazer parte do nosso movimento, com forte atuação em ambientes cloud e ecossistemas containerizados. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência, confiabilidade e escalabilidade das aplicações ao longo de todo o seu ciclo de vida — da estruturação da infraestrutura à operação em produção.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e evoluir ambientes em cloud, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e alta disponibilidade
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código, promovendo padronização e governança dos ambientes
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, assegurando entregas automatizadas e confiáveis
  • Apoiar a estruturação e melhoria de ambientes Kubernetes
  • Monitorar aplicações e infraestrutura, atuando de forma preventiva e corretiva quando necessário
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes e/ou na implementação de melhorias estruturais
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, apoiando decisões técnicas e evoluções arquiteturais.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência sólida com Kubernetes, atuando em ambientes produtivos
  • Vivência prática com Cloud (AWS, GCP ou OCI)
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código, especialmente Terraform
  • Experiência com práticas de GitOps, utilizando Argo CD
  • Experiência com CI/CD, principalmente utilizando GitLab CI, incluindo: criação e manutenção de pipelines, estratégias de deploy automatizado, integração com ambientes Kubernetes e versionamento e controle de releases
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade, como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace
  • Experiência com containers (Docker)
  • Vivência com troubleshooting e sustentação de ambientes críticos.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance

About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.

About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.

What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery

What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team

You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines

Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE

How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)

Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

title: Legal Architect (Remote)
description:
About Lovie

Lovie is an AI-powered platform that helps anyone, anywhere launch a US company.

We build for solopreneurs, creators, and vibe coders — people who move fast, think independently, and use AI as a creative partner.

We're a small, remote-first team building calm, powerful infrastructure for the next generation of internet builders.

What This Role Is

You are the legal architect of our company formation engine.

Your job is to turn complex US legal requirements into clean, automated, AI-native systems that feel simple and frictionless to founders.

You will own the accuracy, structure, and scalability of our formation service.

What You Absolutely NeedDeep, Hands-On US Formation Experience

You must have real operational experience with:

  • LLC vs C-Corp structures (pros, cons, founder fit)
  • Delaware and Wyoming state filing processes
  • EIN applications and IRS processes
  • BOI reporting requirements
  • Registered Agent requirements
  • Operating Agreements, Bylaws, and core post-formation compliance

You've filed, managed, and maintained entities yourself. This cannot be theoretical knowledge.

Systems & Automation Mindset

You:

  • Break complex legal processes into clean, logical workflows
  • Think in systems, not tasks
  • Document clearly and structure information well
  • Obsess over eliminating friction

If something is repetitive, your instinct is to automate it.

Strong Vibe Coding Energy (Non-Negotiable)

You don't need to be a software engineer — but you think like one.

You:

  • Use AI tools daily
  • Prototype solutions before escalating
  • Enjoy no-code / low-code tools
  • Treat AI as a collaborator, not a novelty
  • Care about flow, elegance, and simplicity

You believe great infrastructure should feel invisible.

Clear Communication

You can:

  • Explain complex legal topics in plain English
  • Write structured documentation
  • Operate effectively in async, remote environments
Lovie Culture

We are:

Life-First.

We optimize for energy, not hours. Autonomy is default.

Calm Builders.

We reject hustle culture. We move deliberately and ship thoughtfully.

Low Ego, High Ownership.

No politics. No posturing. Just strong operators building clean systems.

AI-Native.

We don't bolt AI on top. We build with it from the beginning.

Vibe Coder Friendly.

  • We value intuition, speed, experimentation, and creative problem-solving.

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We're privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word 'partner' over 'vendor', and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.

The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.

What do you need to know?

  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code's consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance

About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.

About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.

What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery

What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team

You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines

Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE

How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)

Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

DON'T USE AI FOR QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS -

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We're privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word 'partner' over 'vendor', and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.

The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.

What do you need to know?

  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code's consultants are allocated to perform its services.

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em redes (DNS, Load Balancer, NAT, Security Groups, VPC Peering).
  • Experiência com scripts de automação (Bash, Python ou Shell Script).
  • Vivência com ambientes distribuídos, alta disponibilidade, DR, backups e escalabilidade.
  • Experiência com incident response, RCA e post-mortem.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações AWS, Azure ou DevOps.
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (EKS/AKS).

Aqui, performance tem propósito, estrutura tem calor humano e ambição anda junto com ética.

Nosso produto opera em alta escala, com milhões de interações diárias e desafios constantes de disponibilidade, performance, segurança e automação. Esse crescimento exige um(a) DevOps Sênior com forte autonomia técnica, visão sistêmica e capacidade real de execução.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como referência técnica em infraestrutura e DevOps, apoiando decisões estratégicas da companhia.
  • Projetar, operar e evoluir ambientes cloud altamente disponíveis, escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Construir, manter e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD com foco em automação, segurança e confiabilidade.
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código, garantindo padronização, rastreabilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Atuar ativamente em troubleshooting de ambientes críticos, incidentes, RCA e melhoria contínua.
  • Garantir práticas sólidas de observabilidade, monitoramento, logs e alertas.
  • Atuar com mindset de eficiência operacional, performance, custo (FinOps) e confiabilidade.
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com Engenharia, Arquitetura, Produto e Segurança.

O que valorizamos

  • Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de transformar estratégia em execução real.
  • Autonomia, senso de ownership e responsabilidade técnica.
  • Mentalidade de automação e melhoria contínua.
  • Capacidade analítica e excelência em troubleshooting.
  • Comunicação clara com times técnicos e áreas de negócio.
  • Postura colaborativa e orientada a entregas.
  • Visão de confiabilidade e cultura SRE aplicada na prática.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida (5+ anos) atuando como DevOps ou Cloud Engineer.
  • Domínio em AWS (ECS, ECR, S3, CloudFront, RDS/Aurora, Lambda, IAM, Route53, VPC).
  • Experiência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Infraestrutura como Código com Terraform (principal) e/ou CloudFormation.
  • Experiência com Docker e orquestração (ECS/Fargate; EKS/Kubernetes como diferencial).
  • Observabilidade com Datadog e CloudWatch (logs, métricas, tracing e alertas).
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em redes (DNS, Load Balancer, NAT, Security Groups, VPC Peering).
  • Experiência com scripts de automação (Bash, Python ou Shell Script).
  • Vivência com ambientes distribuídos, alta disponibilidade, DR, backups e escalabilidade.
  • Experiência com incident response, RCA e post-mortem.
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevSecOps e governança de infraestrutura.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações AWS, Azure ou DevOps.
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (EKS/AKS).
  • Vivência com Zero Trust, Cloudflare, WAF e segurança avançada.
  • Atuação em ambientes de alta escala e baixa latência.
  • Experiência com pipelines multiambiente (Dev, Staging e Prod).

Modelo de contratação e ambiente

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Local: Presencial — Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte, liberdade técnica e foco em inovação.
  • Estrutura horizontal, com autonomia para propor, testar e evoluir soluções.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e Odontológico – (disponível para empresas com CNPJ ativo há pelo menos 6 meses);
  • Cartão Caju;
  • TotalPass;
  • Estacionamento conveniado;
  • Descanso Remunerado;
  • DayOff em seu aníversário;
  • Bônus por performance e entregas;
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo, com forte foco em inovação, aprendizado e impacto estratégico.

Por que entrar na Privacy

Estamos evoluindo nossa infraestrutura para sustentar o crescimento acelerado da plataforma.

Aqui, você terá liberdade técnica, proximidade com decisões estratégicas e espaço real para construir, executar e escalar soluções críticas.

Se você busca um ambiente exigente, técnico e com impacto real, essa vaga é para você.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.

Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.

Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.

Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.

Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.

Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.

Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Gerente de operações de franquia
description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Operações de Franquias com perfil estratégico e orientado(a) a indicadores para garantir padronização, rentabilidade e crescimento estruturado da rede no Brasil e no exterior.

Se você tem experiência na gestão de franquias, atuação próxima aos franqueados e foco em performance, essa posição é para você.

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Modalidade: Presencial
  • Horário: 9h às 18h
  • Salário: A Combinar

Principais Atividades

  • Supervisionar e acompanhar as operações das franquias, garantindo aderência aos padrões, processos e diretrizes da empresa.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias operacionais e planos de negócio voltados ao crescimento sustentável da rede.
  • Monitorar indicadores operacionais e financeiros das unidades, garantindo performance e rentabilidade.
  • Atuar na gestão e acompanhamento de P&L das operações franqueadas
  • Apoiar franqueados na gestão do negócio, promovendo eficiência operacional e evolução de resultados.
  • Identificar riscos operacionais e propor planos de ação corretivos e preventivos.
  • Garantir padronização da experiência do cliente em todas as unidades.
  • Apoiar processos de implantação, expansão e maturação das franquias.
  • Conduzir treinamentos, alinhamentos operacionais e acompanhamento de performance das unidades.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com marketing, comercial, expansão e áreas estratégicas do grupo.
  • Apoiar a expansão nacional e internacional, garantindo replicabilidade e segurança operacional.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Gestão Empresarial, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de operações e redes de franquias.
  • Fluência em idiomas estrangeiros (diferencial relevante para atuação internacional).

Diferencial

  • Experiência em redes de estética, saúde ou varejo premium.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack - Remoto

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.

  • Experiência com React ou Angular
  • Domínio de orientação a objetos

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.

We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.

What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.

This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.

Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.

How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: IBM TM1 / Planning Analytics Consultants - WORKING INTO THE US & CANADA
description:
IBM PLANNING ANALYTICS SENIOR TM1 CONSULTANTS

FANTASTIC NEW JOB BASED IN BRAZIL TO WORK INTO CLIENTS IN THE US & CANADA TORONTO!!

CONTRACT OR PERMANENT -

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing financial planning solutions using IBM Planning Analytics to achieve project success as agreed with customers; deliver technical, functional, and business outcomes of a project and maintaining high standards of professional communication.

Accountabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Analysis and evaluation of business requirements through a structured methodical approach
  • Define the solution scope, time, cost and risk by translating business requirements into a set of functional and non-functional deliverables.
  • Estimate and plan project deliverables and success criteria
  • Identify project Risks and Assumptions
  • Communicate with stakeholders, business and technical project teams to ensure the roles and responsibilities for the solution deliver are understood
  • Implementation of financial planning solutions in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 as designed in the solution scope definition
  • Identify all potential Change Requests and work with designated Principal Consultant/ Project Manager on these variations
  • Participate in Post Implementation Review and assume ownership of any actions

Desired Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Greater than 5 years' experience in delivering financial planning applications (IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 will be highly valued);
  • Minimum education level of Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant subject – Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Finance & Accounting;
  • Proven project experience delivering financial planning solutions covering most phases of the project lifecycle including scoping, requirements gathering, design, development, testing and deployment while using project management methodologies;
  • In-depth knowledge and senior level expertise in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 including cube design, turbo integrator processes & rule engine; IBM Cognos TM1 Certified Developer would be an added advantage;
  • A genuine talent for grasping complex business problems and engineering effective solutions;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Highly Regarded

  • Background in finance and understanding of financial processes such as budgeting & forecasting or supply chain roles is desirable;
  • Well developed skills/ability researching, designing and implementing customer solutions and programs;
  • Strong relationship management;
  • Ability to identify opportunities and taking action to help achieve business goals;
  • Ability to identify process improvement opportunities;
  • Team player with a professional, pro-active approach
  • Citizenship is highly regarded but not essential.

title: Kotlin Backend Developer | Mid (Remote)
description:
Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Avaliar, discutir e contribuir com a definição da arquitetura de sistemas;
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em arquiteturas e sistemas;
  • Analisar, documentar, codificar, revisar código, depurar, testar e entregar aplicações;
  • Cuidar da monitoração do ambiente e criar ações proativas que garantam a saúde da plataforma;
  • Interagir com equipes e áreas correlatas;
  • Contribuir com melhorias de processos da engenharia.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Conhecimento em estrutura de dados e paradigma de orientação a objetos;
  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e microserviços;
  • Experiência com Java e/ou Kotlin;
  • Experiência com Spring (Boot, Data, Cloud, etc);
  • Experiência com Git, Gradle/Maven e ferramentas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais como Oracle e/ou MySQL;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de API REST;

  • Experiência com Node.js e/ou Python;

title: IBM TM1 / Planning Analytics Consultants - WORKING INTO THE US & CANADA
description:
IBM PLANNING ANALYTICS SENIOR TM1 CONSULTANTS

FANTASTIC NEW JOB BASED IN BRAZIL TO WORK INTO CLIENTS IN THE US & CANADA TORONTO!!

CONTRACT OR PERMANENT -

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing financial planning solutions using IBM Planning Analytics to achieve project success as agreed with customers; deliver technical, functional, and business outcomes of a project and maintaining high standards of professional communication.

Accountabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Analysis and evaluation of business requirements through a structured methodical approach
  • Define the solution scope, time, cost and risk by translating business requirements into a set of functional and non-functional deliverables.
  • Estimate and plan project deliverables and success criteria
  • Identify project Risks and Assumptions
  • Communicate with stakeholders, business and technical project teams to ensure the roles and responsibilities for the solution deliver are understood
  • Implementation of financial planning solutions in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 as designed in the solution scope definition
  • Identify all potential Change Requests and work with designated Principal Consultant/ Project Manager on these variations
  • Participate in Post Implementation Review and assume ownership of any actions

Desired Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Greater than 5 years' experience in delivering financial planning applications (IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 will be highly valued);
  • Minimum education level of Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant subject – Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Finance & Accounting;
  • Proven project experience delivering financial planning solutions covering most phases of the project lifecycle including scoping, requirements gathering, design, development, testing and deployment while using project management methodologies;
  • In-depth knowledge and senior level expertise in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 including cube design, turbo integrator processes & rule engine; IBM Cognos TM1 Certified Developer would be an added advantage;
  • A genuine talent for grasping complex business problems and engineering effective solutions;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Highly Regarded

  • Background in finance and understanding of financial processes such as budgeting & forecasting or supply chain roles is desirable;
  • Well developed skills/ability researching, designing and implementing customer solutions and programs;
  • Strong relationship management;
  • Ability to identify opportunities and taking action to help achieve business goals;
  • Ability to identify process improvement opportunities;
  • Team player with a professional, pro-active approach
  • Citizenship is highly regarded but not essential.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend's \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You'll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Location

Fully Remote position.

Requisition Number:

Experience Level: Mid to Senior

Job Family: Engineering/Science/Technology

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

Employee Group: Temporary

Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend's \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You'll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $12,000 – $14,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English (French is a plus)

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP

We're hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.

At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.

About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.

Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.

We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.

We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.

What You'll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified

We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French knowledge is a plus (helps with context; fluency not required)
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones

Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability

If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we'd be happy to hear from you.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend's \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You'll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $12,000 – $14,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English (French is a plus)

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP

We're hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.

At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.

About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.

Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.

We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.

We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.

What You'll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified

We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French knowledge is a plus (helps with context; fluency not required)
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones

Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability

If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we'd be happy to hear from you.
